test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

I __go to his house__ personally so that I could persuade him to continue his studies.
solution:
The correct answer is: **went to his house **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the sentence suggests that the action of going to his house happened in the past. 
 
• The use of "**could**" in the original sentence implies a conditional aspect to the action of persuading, which aligns with past tens
